name: DigitalOcean Managed Databases

evidence.nosql: C02: managed document database (MongoDB) is listed; C12: MongoDB has a displayed plan price
evidence.sql: C02: managed SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) are a main type; D01: PostgreSQL 15-18 and MySQL 8.4
evidence.kv: C02: managed Valkey key/value service; D01: Valkey 8 and 9
evidence.vector: V01: PostgreSQL vector(1536) supported; OpenSearch k-NN graph indexes

line: Managed PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Valkey, OpenSearch, and Kafka clusters.

cells.metered: PG/MySQL Standard $15.15/mo table; docs say from $15
cells.regions: 12 shared locations; some regions have limited plans

sql.math: The cost is capped at $15.15 a month, because 730 hours × $0.02254 an hour would be more. Engine docs also say from $15.
The provisioned node still costs $15.15 a month with zero traffic. Engine docs also say from $15.

files.math: Managed databases do not provide file storage.

jobs.math: Three Kafka brokers cost $148.80 a month. Separate worker costs are not priced, so the full job total is unknown.
